es.dash.appearance.title: Apariencia
es.dash.appearance.subtitle: Tema, color e idioma del launcher.

es.dash.appearance.systemDesc: Sistema copia el modo claro u oscuro de Windows.
es.dash.appearance.langDesc: Cambia los textos del launcher entre español e inglés.
es.dash.accent.title: Color del cliente
es.dash.accent.desc: Un color para el launcher, el menú principal y la Suite en el juego. Se aplica al instante.
es.dash.motion.title: Movimiento reducido
es.dash.motion.desc: Desactiva el movimiento del fondo y las animaciones del menú principal.
es.dash.engine.title: Descargas, Java y arranque
es.dash.engine.subtitle: Opciones para afinar cómo se instala y arranca el juego.
es.dash.memory.title: Memoria para el juego
es.dash.memory.desc: Memoria máxima para las instancias sin ajuste propio. En automático se adapta a tu PC; el juego empieza con poca y crece si la necesita.
es.dash.memory.recommended: Recomendado para la mayoría de versiones y modpacks
es.dash.downloads.title: Descargas simultáneas
es.dash.downloads.desc: Descargas a la vez al instalar el juego, sus bibliotecas y mods.

es.dash.jdk.desc: El launcher elige Java por ti; pon una ruta a java.exe solo si quieres usar otro.
es.dash.jdk.statusErr: Error al verificar el ejecutable Java
es.dash.jdk.autoDetect: Detección automática de Java activa (bundled → FastClient → PATH → Adoptium)
es.dash.game.title: Juego
es.dash.game.subtitle: Memoria y opciones mientras juegas.
es.dash.aot.title: Arranque optimizado (AOT)
es.dash.aot.desc: Genera una caché de clases AOT (~140 MB) tras la primera sesión. En nuestras pruebas en JDK 25 recortó el arranque alrededor de un 13–19%; el resultado depende de tu equipo.
es.dash.fastboot.title: Arranque rápido
es.dash.fastboot.desc: Limita el compilador JIT a C1 durante el inicio, lo que acortó el arranque en torno a un 13% en nuestras pruebas. A cambio, sesiones muy largas pueden tener algo menos de FPS máximos.
es.dash.closeOnStart.title: Cerrar el launcher al entrar al juego
es.dash.closeOnStart.desc: Cuando Minecraft llega al menú, el launcher se cierra y libera unos 500 MB; el juego sigue abierto. Recomendado en PCs con 8 GB o menos.
es.dash.discord.title: Mostrar en Discord
es.dash.discord.desc: Muestra en tu perfil que estás jugando con Espectral Client.
es.dash.fullbright.title: Brillo máximo al jugar
es.dash.fullbright.desc: Fija el brillo del juego al máximo de Minecraft en cada arranque.

en.dash.title: Settings
en.dash.subtitle: Appearance, memory and how the launcher behaves.
en.dash.appearance.title: Appearance
en.dash.appearance.subtitle: Theme, colour and launcher language.
en.dash.appearance.themeDesc: Choose how the launcher looks: dark, light or matching your system.
en.dash.appearance.systemDesc: System mode follows Windows light or dark mode.
en.dash.appearance.langDesc: Switch the launcher's texts between Spanish and English.
en.dash.accent.title: Client colour
en.dash.accent.desc: One colour for the launcher, the main menu and the in-game Suite. Applies instantly.
en.dash.motion.title: Reduced motion
en.dash.motion.desc: Turns off background movement and main-menu animations.
en.dash.engine.title: Downloads, Java & startup
en.dash.engine.subtitle: Options to fine-tune how the game installs and starts.
en.dash.memory.title: Memory for the game
en.dash.memory.desc: Maximum RAM for instances without their own setting. Automatic adapts to your PC; the game starts small and grows if it needs to.
en.dash.memory.recommended: Recommended for most Minecraft versions and modpacks
en.dash.downloads.title: Simultaneous downloads
en.dash.downloads.desc: How many files download at once when installing the game, its libraries and mods.
en.dash.jdk.title: Custom Java (JDK)
en.dash.jdk.desc: The launcher picks Java for you; set a java.exe path only if you want a different one.
en.dash.jdk.autoDetect: Automatic Java detection active (bundled → FastClient → PATH → Adoptium)
en.dash.game.title: Game
en.dash.game.subtitle: Memory and options while you play.
en.dash.aot.title: Optimised startup (AOT)
en.dash.aot.desc: Generates an AOT class cache (~140 MB) after the first launch session. In our testing on JDK 25 this cut boot time by roughly 13–19%; your results depend on your hardware.
en.dash.fastboot.title: Fast startup
en.dash.fastboot.desc: Limits the JIT compiler to C1 during startup, which cut boot time by around 13% in our testing. Tradeoff: very long sessions may see slightly lower peak FPS.
en.dash.closeOnStart.title: Close the launcher when the game starts
en.dash.closeOnStart.desc: Once Minecraft reaches its menu, the launcher closes and frees about 500 MB; the game keeps running. Recommended on PCs with 8 GB or less.
en.dash.discord.title: Show on Discord
en.dash.discord.desc: Shows on your profile that you are playing with Espectral Client.
en.dash.fullbright.title: Maximum brightness in game
en.dash.fullbright.desc: Sets the game's brightness to the Minecraft maximum on every launch.
en.dash.data.title: Folders & diagnostics
en.dash.data.subtitle: Where the launcher keeps instances, logs and mods.
en.dash.data.rootDesc: Instances, libraries and logs live here.
en.dash.health.title: Diagnostics
en.dash.health.subtitle: Status of the launcher's engine.
en.dash.about.title: About Espectral Client
en.dash.about.tagline: Next-generation launcher for Minecraft and the Espectral competitive community.
en.dash.about.supportBanner: Want to support development and unlock exclusive perks?
en.dash.about.rankPerks: VIP ranks, exclusive chats, private UHCs & cosmetics
en.settings.advancedSummary: Downloads, Java, startup, agent access, folders and diagnostics.
en.settings.downloadConcurrencyHint: How many files download at once. More finishes sooner but asks more of your connection; 6 is a good balance.
en.settings.flash.closeOnStartOn: The launcher will close once the game reaches its menu.
en.settings.flash.closeOnStartOff: The launcher will stay open while you play.
en.settings.jdkPathHint: Empty = the launcher finds Java for you.
en.settings.memory.invalid: Memory must be an integer between 512 and 65536 MB.
en.settings.memoryHint: More memory does not mean more FPS: on low-RAM PCs, less is better.
en.settings.name: Name
en.settings.openFolderError: Opening the folder is not available in this engine version.
